title: Lesson 3: The Agent Loop: Perceive, Reason, Act, Observe, and Where Your Code Lives
description: The one while loop that turns a language model into an agent: the five stages of the loop, the pseudocode that runs underneath every framework, and exactly which parts of it are your code versus the runtime's.
